title: Overlapping bookings
prompt: can_book(table, s, e) should reject a new booking from time s to time e that overlaps any live reservation on that table. Tap the line that lets double bookings through.
code: if r.start <= s and e <= r.end:
bad_line: if r.start <= s and e <= r.end:
why: That only catches bookings sitting entirely inside an existing one. Two ranges overlap when s < r.end and e > r.start.

title: Two hosts, one table
prompt: Slots are fixed 30-minute blocks. Two hosts book the last 7:00 table at the same moment. What prevents a double booking?
options: Check availability, then insert the booking
Refresh the host screen every few seconds
Retry the insert if the first attempt fails
why: Check-then-insert races: both checks pass before either insert lands. A unique constraint makes the database reject the second booking.

title: Splitting the bill
prompt: split_bill divides a bill of cents among n people, and the shares should add up to the total. Which bill breaks it?
why: $100.00 is 10000 cents. Divided by 3 and rounded down, that is 3333, so the shares add up to 9999 and a cent disappears. Hand the remainder to the first shares.

title: Three per minute
prompt: allow() should permit at most 3 calls per user in any 60 seconds. What happens to the call at t=30?
input: calls_since counts the user's saved calls later than the given time, and save_call saves one. No calls are saved yet. The user calls at t = 0, 10, 20 and 30 seconds.
options: Allowed, as the 4th call in a minute
Rejected, because the limit of 3 is reached
Allowed, because the t=0 call has expired
Rejected, because t=0 is counted twice
correct: Allowed, as the 4th call in a minute
why: At t=30, calls_since returns 3, and 3 > 3 is false, so a 4th call gets through. The check should be n >= LIMIT.

title: Placing an order
prompt: Put the checkout steps in the order that never charges for stock you can't ship.
steps: Charge the card with an idempotency key
why: Reserve stock before charging so a sold-out item is never billed, and only email once the order is confirmed.

title: Billing by the hour
prompt: The garage bills every started hour in full after a 15-minute grace period, and mins is the time parked in minutes. Tap the wrong line.
why: Rounding down bills 61 minutes as one hour and 50 minutes as nothing. A started hour counts, so use round_up(mins / 60).
